name: Kraska dlja volos
source:
In a world of strict division into classes based on magic power, there lives a very ordinary boy named Neko-kun. The only thing he cares about right now is urgently getting a hair dye 

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/topic-223504963_53039962]VK[/url]]
translation:
在一個以魔力強弱嚴格劃分階級的世界裡，生活著一個再普通不過的男孩貓君。他眼下唯一在意的事，就是趕快弄到染髮劑。
